sigdiff.mjs reports the coin's field, sun, dunes and bevel as differing on every medallion frame: the canvas states them as CSS boxes with backgrounds and radii, and the app draws them as SVG shapes at the same coordinates. mdiff.mjs pairs those rows and forgives exactly the background/radius/shadow columns where the app side is bare, plus a `50%` written as a pixel radius. Nothing else. It forgives those columns on ANY such row, so it cannot tell a translated paint server from a lost one — never call a medallion frame clean on mdiff alone.

note: sigdiff/audit report these on the boards and ladders and they are none of them defects. (1) The two background washes — `filter: blur()` has no RN equivalent, BRIEF rule 3 / D015. (2) `radius: 50% → -` on the coin's field, sun and dunes: the canvas states CSS boxes, the app draws SVG shapes at the same coordinates (audit's `paint-absent-geometry-exact` bucket — confirmed in the PNGs at 2–5x). (3) `radius: 50% → 2.25px` on the three page dots, and `50% → 9999px` on any circle: notation. (4) ONE uncategorised row per board: the mount ring. The canvas hangs `0 0 0 1.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2), 0 0 0 7px <mount>, 0 0 0 8.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.16)` on the 150x150 disc itself and the app hangs it on the 150x150 wrapper immediately outside it, so the design's two boxes at 121.5,128,150,150 pair one apart and the shadow reads as `- -> …` on the first and `… -> -` on the second. Both boxes are the same square at the same origin; the ring lands on the same pixels, measured. Do not chase it.
